privacy.ai_training_note: Responsible AI Policy states: 'No AI model training using Customer Personal Data: Customer Personal Data is never used to train any AI or large language model.' VWO Copilot is powered by third-party AI models including OpenAI LLMs, Google Gemini, and image-generation models. AI features use Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs), encryption in transit and at rest, plus anonymization/pseudonymization. Every AI suggestion requires human validation before implementation; no automated decisioning affecting individuals without human oversight.
privacy.data_region: Customer-selectable GCP region at account setup: europe-west1 (Belgium/EU), us-east4 (N. Virginia/USA), or asia-south1 (Mumbai/India). EU selection keeps visitor/user data in the EU only.

security.name: Hosting / infrastructure
security.value: All customer data hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 'Kein Mitarbeiter von VWO kann physisch auf die Daten zugreifen' (no VWO employee can physically access the data). Sub-processors: Google Cloud, Cloudflare (CDN, global), Amazon Web Services (USA).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Encryption in transit and at rest (PCI scope: 'Verschluesselung von Daten in Bewegung und im Ruhezustand'). Data-at-rest encryption applied based on sensitivity. AI features use strong encryption in transit and at rest.

security.name: Penetration testing (VAPT)
security.value: Annual third-party Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing plus quarterly security audits of all production systems: 'Wingify runs Vulnerability Assessment Penetration Testing (VAPT) on an annual basis through a third-party service provider and performs quarterly security audits for all production environment systems.'

security.name: Responsible disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: Self-hosted Responsible Disclosure program (NOT HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Report to security@wingify.com; 72 working-hour initial confirmation; Security Researcher Hall of Fame recognition. Scope: vwo.com, app.vwo.com. No paid bounty advertised.

security.name: Privacy governance
security.value: Appointed Data Protection Officer; Corporate Security & Compliance Committee (CSCC) meeting quarterly; ROPA maintained per GDPR Art. 30; annual Privacy Impact Assessment validated by external auditor; least-privilege / role-based access; ISO 27001:2022 ISMS as baseline control framework.

security.name: Data subject rights tooling
security.value: Customers can export or delete visitor/app-user data via UUID. Keystrokes anonymized by default; last IP octet zeroed by default; PII (email, credit card) filtered out of incoming custom-dimension data by default; Do-Not-Track honoring configurable.

products.name: VWO Testing
products.category: A/B testing & experimentation (web, mobile app, feature, server-side)
products.data_scope: Visitor behavioral data, experiment assignment, conversion metrics. SmartCode (client) and SDKs (8+ languages) for server-side.
products.notes: Visual editor (no-code) plus code editor and SDK-based testing.

products.name: VWO Insights
products.category: Behavioral analytics (heatmaps, session recordings, funnels, form analytics, surveys)
products.data_scope: Captures session recordings and heatmaps; keystrokes anonymized by default, text-masking and CSS-selector whitelisting available to avoid storing PII.
products.notes: Highest privacy sensitivity of the suite because of session recordings; relies on default anonymization controls.

products.name: VWO Data360
products.data_scope: Unifies user attributes, user events, third-party data, and offline data for a 360-degree customer view; event-driven architecture.
products.notes: Broadest data-ingestion surface; customers can bring first-party and offline data.

products.name: VWO Personalize
products.data_scope: Uses customer data and segments to deliver targeted experiences.
products.notes: Consumes CDP segments for real-time targeting.

products.name: VWO Web Rollouts & Plan
products.data_scope: Progressive feature delivery; planning workflow metadata.

products.name: VWO AI / Copilot
products.category: AI assistant (analysis, idea generation, campaign build, summarization)
products.data_scope: Operates over campaign and behavioral data; powered by third-party LLMs (OpenAI, Google Gemini). Customer Personal Data is NOT used to train models; PETs and masking applied; human validation required.
products.notes: Third-party LLM sub-processors are the key new data-flow consideration for AI-cautious buyers; no model training on customer data.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription SaaS with free trial; tiered/enterprise plans (per-product and platform bundles). Demo/sales-led for enterprise.
compare.data_residency: Customer-selectable at account creation: EU (Belgium), US (N. Virginia), or India (Mumbai) on GCP.
